title: A 3-night Mombasa trip mixes standard-rate and above-cap accommodation nights
description: Esther Wanjiku Kamau (Procurement Manager) travels to Mombasa for 3 nights to conduct supplier due diligence. Two nights are booked at KES 12,000, the OPS-POL-001 cap, but the only room available for the third night costs KES 15,000.
businessContext: OPS-POL-001 reimburses accommodation up to KES 12,000 per night unless an approved exception is recorded before commitment.

events.event: Two nights of accommodation are booked at KES 12,000 per night, within the standard cap.
The third night is only available at KES 15,000, above the standard cap.
An exception request is documented and approved before the booking is committed.

expectedOutcome: The first two nights at KES 12,000 require no exception, since they sit exactly at the OPS-POL-001 cap. The third night at KES 15,000 exceeds the cap and requires a documented exception approved before the booking is committed, not claimed afterward.
relevantFacts: Two nights are booked at KES 12,000; one night is booked at KES 15,000.
OPS-POL-001: 'Accommodation is reimbursed up to KES 12,000 per night unless an approved exception is recorded.'
FIN-POL-001: 'Meal claims are capped at KES 3,000 per person per meal and accommodation at KES 12,000 per night unless a documented exception is approved before commitment.'
requiredReasoning: Compare each night's rate against the KES 12,000 cap individually.
Identify that only the night above the cap requires an exception.
Confirm the exception must be approved before commitment, not after the fact.
